description.value: Church Street Taphouse is a locally owned craft beer bar and full-service restaurant in downtown Comox on Vancouver Island, boasting the Comox Valley's largest craft beer selection alongside cocktails, mocktails, and an extensive wine list. The kitchen serves shareables, bowls, soups and sandwiches, and desserts, with many items labeled gluten-free or dairy-free. The venue sits in bikeable downtown Comox and the website explicitly notes it is 'only a bike ride or walk away.'

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 13m; rack (4 spaces) at 81m; wall_loops (2 spaces) at 95m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Church Street Taphouse as an active craft beer bar and restaurant at 215 Church St, Comox, BC, with a matching phone number and address. The food menu explicitly labels numerous items GF, GFO, DF, and DFO, and includes a vegetarian tofu dish, confirming dietary options. No explicit mention of bike racks, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi was found on the site, though the contact page notes the venue is 'only a bike ride or walk away' and is in walkable/bikeable downtown Comox.
